propositions: The review-bot-ops runbook instructs operators to run commands on the prod box via SSM Session Manager but never states the instance id or region, forcing operators to guess.
The prod region is single-sourced in terraform (var.aws_region default us-east-1, versions.tf backend) and the instance id lives in ADR-0026, but neither is in the operational runbook.
Add a 'The box (where prod runs)' reference section naming the prod instance id, region traced to var.aws_region/versions.tf, account id, and SSM start-session/send-command connect snippets.
Include an accurate autodeploy self-update note: the autodeploy.sh body auto-updates in place via BOT_PATHS rsync.
Only the installer (install-autodeploy.sh) and unit files are excluded from in-run re-materialization and always require hand-deploy.
A commit touching only autodeploy.sh triggers no deploy, so script-only changes must be hand-deployed to go live immediately.
